text_block_list.text:
With the Takarazuka Kinen behind her and 
her target race, the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
fast approaching, Silence Suzuka is all 
fired up.

Amidst all this, she spent her days 
training hard in preparation for her next 
race, the Mainichi Okan.

El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder were also 
eagerly awaiting the next race where they 
would battle Silence Suzuka.

At the Mainichi Okan... A clash of 
top-tier Umamusume from different 
generations was about to unfold!
